app.title: WTFTD
filters.title: Filters
filters.hiddenHint: AI, removed and unreleased units found in the game files. May crash or behave oddly.
sort.name: Name
tree.empty: This nation has no tree for this vehicle type.
scenario.hint: Official Test Drive / Test Flight missions, with their targets. Your vehicle replaces the default one.
scenario.showAll: Show scenarios for other vehicle types
loadout.none: This vehicle has a single loadout.
loadout.note: Custom pylon-by-pylon loadouts need custom vehicles (Settings) and a vehicle with weapon slots — otherwise every official preset is available.
ammo.overCap: Over capacity — the game may clamp it.
ammo.unofficial: Not normally available on this vehicle
ammo.beltNote: Belts are matched to gun groups in order (best effort).
adv.heading: Heading override
adv.title: Mission title (shown in game)
toast.generatedHint: In game: Single missions → User missions → “{title}”.
missions.title: Generated missions
missions.hint: Files created by WTFTD in your UserMissions folder.
missions.empty: No mission yet. Pick a vehicle and create one!
setups.title: Saved setups
settings.title: Settings
settings.gameDirHint: Leave empty to detect automatically (Steam & standalone).
settings.dataHint: Vehicles, loadouts and scenarios come from the community War Thunder datamine. Update after a game patch.
settings.howtoText: WTFTD writes a mission file into War Thunder's UserMissions folder. Start the game, open Single missions → User missions and pick it.
onboard.title: Welcome to WTFTD
onboard.text: First launch: WTFTD downloads the game data once (≈1 GB from the community War Thunder datamine, a few minutes) and builds its database on your PC. You can keep this window open.
preview.title: Mission file preview
mods.off: Enable custom vehicles in Settings to modify stats.
mods.note: Custom vehicle: the mission uses a copy of this vehicle loaded in place of “{host}” (a vehicle you own). Only one custom vehicle per type at a time — the last mission you create defines it.
toast.cdkRemoved: Removed {n} custom vehicle file(s) from the game folder
settings.cdkHint: Uses War Thunder's userVehicles mechanism (content/pkg_local): your vehicle is loaded in place of a host vehicle you own, so missions work without buying it. Only new files are written; nothing replaces game files. Not endorsed by Gaijin — use at your own risk.
settings.hostsHint: Host vehicles must be owned (reserve vehicles are). With “New custom aircraft”, aircraft and helicopters don't need a host.
mods.noteAir: Custom aircraft: WTFTD creates a new aircraft (copy of this one with your changes) in content/pkg_user — no host needed. Experimental.
cheat.immortalHint: Your vehicle can’t be destroyed. With custom vehicles its damage model is made 1000× tougher; otherwise it is repaired / respawned instantly.
cheat.infAmmoHint: The game refills your ammo when you run out.
cheat.noReloadHint: Instant rearm, and near-instant reload on every gun.
cheat.noReloadCdk: (Gun reload needs custom vehicles — only rearm is instant now.)
cheat.passiveHint: Enemy units of the scenario can't fire.
cheat.repairHint: Fully repairs and rearms your vehicle every N seconds.
settings.autoUpdate: Update automatically when the game is patched (checks every 3 h)
theme.label: Theme
targets.title: Training targets
targets.hint: Enemy units of this scenario: {what}. Pick their level — WTFTD swaps them for vehicles of the same type and BR, mixed across nations.
targets.fixed: This scenario's targets are built into the game's templates and can't be changed.
cheat.crewHint: Max crew skills, plus the expert / ace qualification events use. Untested in user missions.
editor.title: Scenario editor
editor.intro: Move, add or remove allies and enemies on the real map of the scenario, and choose how they behave.
editor.hintSelect: Click a unit to edit it · drag units (and you) to move them · Del removes the selected unit · drag the map to pan · wheel to zoom
editor.hintAdd: Click on the map to place a new enemy
editor.noSel: Select a unit on the map or in the list.
editor.noUnits: This scenario has no editable unit (its targets come from the game's templates). You can still add units.
editor.playerHint: Drag your marker on the map to move your start. Height is above sea level.
editor.heightHint: No heightmap for this map: estimated from the nearest unit; raise it if the vehicle spawns underground.
editor.removedHint: This unit is removed from the mission.
loadout.copyPreset: Click to copy this preset into your custom loadout
loadout.gridHint: Rows are the official presets, columns the pylons — click a row to use it. Turn on the custom loadout to fill each pylon yourself.
loadout.pickHint: Click a pylon of the Custom row to choose what it carries.
loadout.more: {n} more — refine with the filter or a category
need.radar: This aircraft has no radar-guided weapon: the missile may never lock.
need.laser: No laser designator on this aircraft: add a targeting pod or it won't guide.
need.saclos: This aircraft has no missile guidance system: the missile will fly unguided.
need.tv: This aircraft has no TV / IR guided weapon: lock-on may not work.
editor.noMap: No map background for this scenario yet: play it once with WTFTD open and its tactical map is captured from the game.
editor.tplNote: This unit comes from one of the game's templates: it can't be moved or changed, but you can remove it, freeze it, make it passive or make it hunt you.
editor.hintAddAlly: Click on the map to place a new ally
editor.noOodle: Map background unavailable: the game's maps are Oodle-compressed and no Oodle runtime (oo2core_*_win64.dll, shipped with many games) was found on this PC. Set one in Settings, or play this scenario once with WTFTD open to capture its map.
editor.mapError: The map background could not be read from the game files.
editor.followHint: Follows you around and engages enemies on its way.
editor.movesHint: This unit follows a route in the scenario: moving it changes where the route starts.
cond.fuelHint: Share of the tanks filled at spawn. "Unlimited fuel" (Cheats) overrides it.
settings.oodleHint: The game's tactical maps are Oodle-compressed. WTFTD uses an oo2core_<n>_win64.dll found in your other games (Steam / Epic folders). Leave empty for automatic.
editor.playerHintAir: Drag your marker to start somewhere else: you then start in the air, at the altitude below (above sea level).
editor.spawnRunway: The scenario spawns you on this runway (dashed line), whatever the position written in the mission.
editor.spawnArea: The scenario places you here when the mission starts.
editor.spawnMoved: Moved: the scenario's runway / start point is no longer used.
editor.tpStart: The scenario moves this unit here when the mission starts.
editor.tpStartMoved: Moved: the scenario no longer teleports it at start.
editor.tpLater: When destroyed, it respawns at the circled point.
settings.languageHint: Translations other than English were machine-assisted and may contain mistakes — corrections are welcome on GitHub.
stats.title: Performance
filters.statsPickType: Pick a vehicle type to filter by all its stats.
wpick.title: Choose weapons
wpick.hint: Click weapons to select them: vehicles must carry all of them.
share.title: Share this setup
share.text: Send this code to a friend: in WTFTD, they click Saved setups → Import and paste it (or send the .wtftd file). Each of you then plays the same mission on your own PC.
share.importText: Paste the code a friend sent you, or open a .wtftd file (you can also drop it on the window).
share.invalid: This is not a WTFTD setup code.
share.unknownVehicle: This vehicle isn't in your game data ({id}): update the game data in Settings.
share.setupsHint: Saved setups and the ones friends shared with you (Import).
compare.max: Up to {n} vehicles in a comparison
compare.title: Vehicle comparison
app.newVersionHint: You have {v}. Download the new WTFTD.exe from the release page.
app.feedbackHint: Found a bug or have an idea? Tell us on GitHub (a free account is needed).
